name: Snow day
summary: A canceled-classes post becomes the sledding hill: sleds and dining hall trays wait at the top, tap to grab one and your face rides it down to the others, and whoever brings trays shows under the hill.
useWhen: who has trays from the dining hall
dontUseWhen: an ordinary plan with no snow or hill (use squad-lock)
a weather check for an outdoor plan (use clear-skies)

title.description: Card title, sentence case, e.g. 'Snow day on Miller Hill'

post.description: The post that started it, e.g. 'Eastfield · classes canceled Tuesday'

place.description: The hill's name on the sign

riders.description: Who is already going, in the order they said so

said.description: What they said about it, in their own words

gear.description: Who is bringing something to ride

kind.description: A dining hall tray or a real sled
